sources.title: DFC - Program Sheet - 010126.pdf
sources.read_as: 300 dpi render. The sheet prints "Revision Date: 8/13/2025" in its own header.

changes.new:
GAP Max$1,500 or state cap (lesser); minimum 70% FELTV or state cap
GAP — NYAvailable through TFS; max $190
Backend AllowanceDollar amount on deal approval; all products must be cancelable
Allowable ProductsService contracts · maintenance packages (lifetime oil) · cancelable bundles with refund · GAP
CancelabilityEvery financed product must be cancelable
Service ContractMust cover at least half the term of the loan
changes.quote: GAP Guidelines: Maximum price $1500 or state cap whichever is less, Minimum 70% FELTV or state cap.
changes.note: WRONG VALUE FIXED. The record required 80% front-end LTV for GAP; the sheet says 70%. Ten points stricter than DFC actually is, so the desk would decline GAP on deals that qualify — the error costs product revenue rather than causing a decline. The record also carried "min $12K financed; 60+mo term", which appears nowhere on this sheet; see ambiguities.

changes.old: ❌Ineligible: Commercial use, cargo vans for delivery, ride-sharing, branded titles, grey market. Vehicles over 14yrs or 175K miles auto-declined.
changes.new:
Used ValueKBB “Lending Value” or J.D. Power “Clean Trade”
One Source OnlyThe dealership must pick one book and cannot switch back and forth between them
Current-Year Used, No Book80% of the “like invoice” new vehicle
New QualificationNever registered, and no older than the current model year as of March 31
New Mileage Cap7,500 mi
Prior-Year “New”Treated as used; if no used value exists, 80% of invoice
CPONo value increase — DFC does not pay a CPO bump
Auto-DeclineOver 14 model years or over 175,000 mi — call for an exception
❌Ineligible: Commercial use, cargo vans for delivery, ride-sharing, branded titles, grey market. Vehicles over 14yrs or 175K miles auto-declined.
changes.quote: Kelly Blue Book "Lending Value" or JD Power "Clean Trade" - Dealership must only use 1 source (Kelly or JD Power) and cannot vary back and forth
changes.note: DFC had no valuation rows at all. The one-source rule is the one to know: the store picks KBB or J.D. Power and is held to it — you cannot book whichever is higher deal by deal. Also notable that DFC gives no CPO value increase, which is the opposite of most of the book and easy to assume wrongly.

changes.quote: Loans over $75,000 require supervisor or above approval and may require additional time to process. No flat or reserve paid on $75,000+
changes.note: The record already noted that no flat or reserve is paid above $75,000, but not that such a deal also needs supervisor sign-off and takes longer — worth knowing before promising a delivery time.

ambiguities.note: dfc has been in acknowledged.json because the filename says 010126 while the record says August 13, 2025. The sheet itself prints "Revision Date: 8/13/2025" in its header, so the RECORD IS RIGHT and the filename is the thing that is wrong. Worth renaming the Drive file to DFC - Program Sheet - 081325.pdf and updating the SOURCES.md row, which would let the acknowledgement be removed entirely rather than carried forever.

The record also states "min $12K financed" and "60+mo term" for GAP. Neither appears on this sheet. They may come from the separate DFC Funding Guidelines PDF (1tjEUJLshnxu5pCEc8RpAObDk7QHqEJuc), which I did not read for this proposal. Left in place rather than deleted — but unverified.

The 13-tier P0-P11 plus No-Hit structure is faithfully collapsed in the record: P0-P4 and P6-P8 really are identical rows on the sheet, so 7 rows x 7 columns is a legitimate compression of the two 13-row tables, and every value matches.
